name: Expedition Ships
line: Out On Deck At The Edge Of The World
lede: Ice-class expedition ships carry a few hundred guests at a time to Antarctica and the Arctic, where the open decks are a treasured part of the journey and the air is cold. Four of them carry Platinum Electric Marine heaters.
data: Scenic Eclipse · World Navigator · SH Minerva · SH Vega

photos.caption: A heater on the deckhead of a promenade deck, Scenic Eclipse. Photograph from Bromic’s marine presentation (2022).
World Navigator. Photograph from Bromic’s marine presentation (2022).

beats: Small expedition ships for polar waters, where guests spend time on open decks, bars and balconies between landings.
Few settings test outdoor heat like the polar regions: the decks have to be welcoming in cold air.
All four ships carry Platinum Smart-Heat Electric Marine heaters. On SH Minerva, Bromic’s presentation names the top-deck bar, the restaurant and the suite balconies.
